_comment: Copy this file to cards.config.json and edit locally. Key = LAST 4 DIGITS of the card number. name = display name. mm = cycle anchor month (01-12, the month the accumulation cycle resets). Optional reserved key _default.mm = fallback applied automatically to any newly-detected card that has no month yet (e.g. '12' = December); existing entries are never overwritten. Optional reserved key _hidden = list of card last-4 to hide on the dashboard by default (the Display Card menu overrides this per browser), e.g. "_hidden": ["6789"]. A legacy 'mmdd' value still works (the build reads its leading MM). cards.config.json is git-ignored so real card numbers never reach the repo. You can also set the cycle month with /set-expiryCard, the display name with /set-cardName, and list every card with /list-cards.
